files.README-OFFLINE-CLIENT.txt:
TabTop offline client (desktop)

Open tabtop.html (double-click: it runs as a file, its scripts from your
disk), enter the address you open TabTop at, and connect. (vnc.html can't
run as a file itself: browsers won't load modules from one file into
another; tabtop.html holds the whole tree, and loads it from blob: URLs.)

It has the desktop (vnc.html), the terminal (tty/), the files page (fs/),
and its own page of components (components/), which link to each other:
tabtop.html?page=terminal, ?page=files and ?page=components.
Syntax colouring, the disassemblers, Kaitai, the 3D viewer, pdf.js, KaTeX
and Mermaid, and the AI image tools are fetched through the tunnel when
first needed, checked against the SHA-256 the gateway wrote into
tabtop.html when it sealed the pack, and kept in the browser. The
previews' frames (Markdown and HTML, EPUB, PDF) are built from the
client's own files. Nothing else is loaded from the server: only the
tunnel connects to it.

Files under tabtop/ are the gateway's scripts; tabtop/noble/ is the crypto
the tunnel needs; tty/ has ghostty-web and JetBrains Mono Nerd Font (their
licences beside them). noVNC's app/, core/, and vendor/ are upstream.

files.app/images/icons/Makefile:
BROWSER_SIZES := 16 24 32 48 64
#ANDROID_SIZES := 72 96 144 192
# FIXME: The ICO is limited to 8 icons due to a Chrome bug:
#        https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1381393
ANDROID_SIZES := 96 144 192
WEB_ICON_SIZES := $(BROWSER_SIZES) $(ANDROID_SIZES)

#IOS_1X_SIZES := 20 29 40 76 # No such devices exist anymore
IOS_2X_SIZES := 40 58 80 120 152 167
IOS_3X_SIZES := 60 87 120 180
ALL_IOS_SIZES := $(IOS_1X_SIZES) $(IOS_2X_SIZES) $(IOS_3X_SIZES)

ALL_ICONS := \
	$(ALL_IOS_SIZES:%=novnc-ios-%.png) \
	novnc.ico

all: $(ALL_ICONS)

# Our testing shows that the ICO file need to be sorted in largest to
# smallest to get the apporpriate behviour
WEB_ICON_SIZES_REVERSE := $(shell echo $(WEB_ICON_SIZES) | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -nr | tr '\n' ' ')
WEB_BASE_ICONS := $(WEB_ICON_SIZES_REVERSE:%=novnc-%.png)
.INTERMEDIATE: $(WEB_BASE_ICONS)

novnc.ico: $(WEB_BASE_ICONS)
	convert $(WEB_BASE_ICONS) "$@"

# General conversion
novnc-%.png: novnc-icon.svg
	convert -depth 8 -background transparent \
		-size $*x$* "$(lastword $^)" "$@"

# iOS icons use their own SVG
novnc-ios-%.png: novnc-ios-icon.svg
	convert -depth 8 -background transparent \
		-size $*x$* "$(lastword $^)" "$@"

# The smallest sizes are generated using a different SVG
novnc-16.png novnc-24.png novnc-32.png: novnc-icon-sm.svg

clean:
	rm -f *.png

<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<style>
:root { --fg: #1d1d1f; --bg: #fff; --line: #ddd; --raised: #fff; --accent: #1a73e8; --hover: rgba(26, 115, 232, .12); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { --fg: #e8e8ea; --bg: #1c1c1e; --line: #3a3a3c; --raised: #2c2c2e;
       --accent: #8ab4f8; --hover: rgba(138, 180, 248, .18); } }
a { color: var(--accent); }
body { font: 15px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 2rem auto; max-width: 56rem;
       padding: 0 1rem; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); }
button, input { font: inherit; }
button:not(.sort) { padding: .3rem .7rem; color: inherit; background: var(--raised); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; }
button:not(.sort):not(:disabled) { cursor: pointer; }
button:not(.sort):not(:disabled):hover { background: var(--hover); }
button.danger, .selection button.delete { color: #c5221f; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { button.danger, .selection button.delete { color: #f28b82; } }
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
h2 { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 2rem; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
th, td { text-align: left; padding: .4rem .5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
td.num, th.num { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
td.name { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; }
.error { color: #c5221f; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .error { color: #f28b82; } }
.hint { opacity: .7; font-size: 13px; }
.bootstrap-pack { margin: 1.25rem 0 .5rem; }
.bootstrap-pack > summary { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; list-style: none; }
.bootstrap-pack > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.bootstrap-pack > summary::before { content: "▸ "; font-weight: normal; opacity: .7; }
.bootstrap-pack[open] > summary::before { content: "▾ "; }
.bootstrap-pack-body { margin-top: .65rem; text-align: center; }
.bootstrap-pack-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .35rem .5rem; margin: .35rem 0; }
.bootstrap-pack-line code { word-break: break-all; }
button.bootstrap-pack-action.glyph { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
	min-width: 1.6rem; min-height: 1.6rem; padding: .1rem .25rem; vertical-align: middle; }
button.bootstrap-pack-action.glyph svg { display: block; width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.build-time { text-align: center; }
p.upload { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; }
p.upload button { font: inherit; }
p.space { margin-top: -.25rem; }
#sessions button.end, #sessions button.name-session { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; }
#shares .shares-table button { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; }
.shares-table td.act { white-space: nowrap; }
#sessions .activity .bar .buttons, #sessions .security-backup .bar .buttons { display: flex; gap: .5rem; }
#sessions .activity button, #sessions .security-backup button, #shares .cleanup button, #shares .shares-bar button { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; }
#sessions .security-backup { margin: 1.25rem 0; }
#shares .shares-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
#sessions .activity .find select { font: inherit; padding: .25rem .4rem; }
.activity-table td:first-child { white-space: nowrap; }
:is(#sessions, #shares) h2 { font-size: 1rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
#sessions p.attention { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .5rem 1rem; padding: .6rem .8rem;
       color: #c5221f; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 8px; }
#sessions p.attention button { color: var(--fg); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { #sessions p.attention { color: #f28b82; } }
h1.crumbs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: .1rem .1rem; word-break: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
       margin: .75rem 0 .5rem; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; }
.tabtop-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .25rem .5rem; padding-bottom: .5rem;
       border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 14px; }
.tabtop-nav .page { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px;
       color: var(--accent); }
.tabtop-nav .page svg { display: block; width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.tabtop-nav a.page:hover { background: var(--hover); }
.tabtop-nav .page[aria-current] { color: var(--fg); background: var(--line); }
.tabtop-nav button { margin-left: auto; font: inherit; }
.tabtop-nav button + button { margin-left: 0; }
.tabtop-nav button.security.attention { position: relative; color: #c5221f; border-color: currentColor; }
.tabtop-nav button.security.attention::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px; width: 9px; height: 9px;
       border-radius: 50%; background: #c5221f; border: 2px solid var(--bg); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .tabtop-nav button.security.attention { color: #f28b82; }
       .tabtop-nav button.security.attention::after { background: #f28b82; } }
.tabtop-nav :is(button.security, button.shares, button.trash)[aria-pressed=true] { color: var(--bg); background: var(--fg); border-color: var(--fg); }
.tabtop-nav :is(button.logout, button.security, button.shares, button.trash) { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
       padding: 3px 6px; }
.tabtop-nav :is(button.logout, button.security, button.shares, button.trash) svg { display: block; width: 22px; height: 22px; }
/* The Starred and Recent menus, at the end of the heading's row. */
.crumbs-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin: .75rem 0 .5rem; }
.crumbs-row h1.crumbs { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; margin: 0; }
.files-pins { display: flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: .15rem; margin-left: auto; }
details.files-pin-menu summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 3px 5px; color: var(--muted, #59636e); }
details.files-pin-menu summary svg { display: block; }
details.files-pin-menu .items { min-width: 14rem; max-width: min(24rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; }
details.files-pin-menu .items .hint { margin: .4rem .6rem; font-size: .85rem; }
details.files-pin-menu .files-pin-link { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .5rem; width: 100%; }
details.files-pin-menu .files-pin-link span { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
details.files-pin-menu .files-pin-link small { flex: none; color: var(--muted, #59636e); font-size: .75rem; }
details.files-pin-menu .files-pin-link:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }
.find { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.find button:is(.search-files, .view-toggle) { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; align-self: stretch; padding: 0 .5rem; }
.find button:is(.search-files, .view-toggle) svg { display: block; }
/* The folder's filter gives way to the buttons after it, so that on a
   phone they stay on its row: it's as wide as there's room for, up to 20rem. */
.find > input.filter:first-child { flex: 1 1 8rem; max-width: 20rem; }
.find button:is(.search-files, .view-toggle) { flex: none; }
.find input { font: inherit; flex: 0 1 20rem; min-width: 0; padding: .3rem .5rem; color: inherit; background: var(--bg);
       border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; }
h1.crumbs a { text-decoration: none; } h1.crumbs a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
h1.crumbs .sep { opacity: .4; font-weight: 400; }
th.sel, td.sel { width: 1%; padding-right: 0; }
tbody tr:focus-within { background: var(--hover); }
.drop-target { outline: 2px dashed var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; background: var(--hover); }

}

.exif-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .6rem .75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.exif-head strong { margin-right: auto; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.exif-status { margin: .5rem .75rem 0; }

       border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: .4rem; background: var(--raised); }
.exif-summary dt { color: #888; }

.exif-shift-tools, .exif-place-tools { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: .2rem .5rem; flex-basis: 100%; }

.exif-shift-tools label { color: #888; font-size: .85rem; }
.exif-shift, .exif-place { font: inherit; padding: .1rem .35rem; color: inherit; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; }
.exif-place { width: 13rem; max-width: 100%; }
.exif-going { color: #c5221f; }

.exif-privacy-action { padding: .2rem .6rem; }

.exif-xmp { flex-basis: 100%; }

.exif-tools input { font: inherit; padding: .25rem .45rem; color: inherit; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; min-width: 0; }
.exif-filter { flex: 1 1 10rem; }
.exif-add-choice { flex: 2 1 14rem; }
.exif-group { margin: 0 0 .4rem; }
.exif-group[hidden] { display: none; }
.exif-group > summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; padding: .3rem 0; }

.exif-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; }
.exif-table th, .exif-table td { text-align: left; vertical-align: top; overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: .35rem .5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }

.exif-table .exif-tag-id { display: block; font-size: .75rem; }
.exif-table td.exif-row-tools { width: 4.6rem; padding-left: 0; padding-right: 0; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.exif-table tr[hidden] { display: none; }
.exif-value { white-space: pre-wrap; }
.exif-value[role="button"] { cursor: text; border-radius: 4px; }
.exif-value[role="button"]:is(:hover, :focus-visible) { background: var(--hover); outline: none; }
.exif-row.changed .exif-value, .exif-row.added .exif-value { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.exif-row.removed :is(th, .exif-value) { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: .55; }
.exif-row.managed :is(th, .exif-value) { color: #888; }
.exif-content.stripping .exif-group { opacity: .8; }
.exif-row-tools button.glyph svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.exif-row-tools button.glyph { padding: .15rem .3rem; border: 0; background: none; display: inline-flex; vertical-align: middle; opacity: .7; }
.exif-row-tools button.glyph:is(:hover, :focus-visible) { opacity: 1; background: var(--hover); }
.exif-editor { display: grid; gap: .3rem; min-width: 0; }

.exif-editor [aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #d0461d; }
.exif-field-error { color: #c5221f; }

.exif-editor-tools { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: .5rem; }
.exif-advanced { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: .85rem; }
.exif-advanced > summary { cursor: pointer; color: #888; }
.exif-field-spec { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem .7rem; margin: .3rem 0; }
.exif-field-spec label, .exif-raw { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; }
.exif-raw { align-items: flex-start; }
.exif-tag { width: 5.5rem; }
.exif-done { padding: .15rem .6rem; }

.exif-actions[hidden] { display: none; }
.exif-changes { margin-right: auto; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.exif-actions button[hidden] { display: none; }

    .exif-summary { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; }
    .exif-summary dd { margin: 0 0 .45rem; }
    .exif-table th { width: 40%; }
    .exif-table td.exif-row-tools { width: 3.6rem; }
}

.glyph-choice { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

.model-bar .glyph-choice-menu button.glyph { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: .5rem; width: 100%; padding: .4rem .6rem; border: 0; }

.glyph-choice-arrow { font-size: .65rem; margin-left: .2rem; }

       border: 3px dashed var(--accent); }

       max-height: 45vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--raised);

#transfers[hidden] { display: none; }

#transfers .head button { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; }

#uploads button { font: inherit; font-size: 12px; }
.sr-status { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden;

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Browser</title>
<style>
:root { --bar-height: 44px;
    /* A phone's notch, rounded corners and home bar (viewport-fit=cover):
       the bar and the page kept clear of them; 0 elsewhere. */
    --safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); --safe-right: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
    --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); --safe-left: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
    --bar-total: calc(var(--bar-height) + var(--safe-top)); }
/* No pull-to-refresh (it would reload this page, not the page shown) nor
   overscroll bounce: a page's own scrolling ends at its ends. */
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #1c1c1e; overflow: hidden; overscroll-behavior: none; font: 13px system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e8e8ea; }
body { height: 100dvh; display: grid; grid-template-rows: var(--bar-total) minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
#go_bar { position: relative; grid-row: 1; height: var(--bar-total); box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: center;
    gap: 4px; padding: var(--safe-top) calc(8px + var(--safe-right)) 0 calc(8px + var(--safe-left)); background: #2c2c2e; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3a3c; }
#go_bar button { flex: 0 0 auto; min-width: 30px; height: 28px; padding: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font: 16px system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e8e8ea; background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
#go_bar button svg { display: block; width: 18px; height: 18px; }
/* A private tab (go.js privateTab): a violet bar edge, and Back wearing its hat and glasses. */
.go-private #go_bar { background: #2e2a38; border-bottom-color: #a78bfa; }
#go_bar #go_back.private { color: #d4c4fb; }
#go_bar #go_back.private svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
#go_bar #go_back.private:disabled { color: #9d8cc4; }
#go_menu_panel .item#go_menu_private[hidden] { display: none; }
#go_bar button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #3a3a3c; }
#go_bar button:disabled { color: #6c6c70; cursor: default; }
/* The address: the site only, but when it's being edited (the whole
   address then); reload, or stop while loading, or clear while editing, at
   its end. */
#go_address { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; }
#go_address input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 28px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 32px 0 10px; font: 14px system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: #e8e8ea; background: #1c1c1e; border: 1px solid #3a3a3c; border-radius: 5px; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
#go_address input.site { text-align: center; }
#go_address input.insecure { color: #f2b8b5; }
#go_bar #go_address button { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; height: auto; min-width: 30px; color: #a8a8ad; }
#go_bar #go_address button[hidden] { display: none; }
/* The tabs, on a phone (go-tabs.js shows them all). */
#go_tabs .count { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 3px;

<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Markdown</title>
<style>/* A Markdown preview, in its frame (see md-frame.js): GitHub's look, light
   and dark as the browser is set. */
:root { color-scheme: light dark; --fg: #1f2328; --bg: #fff; --muted: #59636e; --line: #d1d9e0; --code: #f6f8fa;
        --accent: #0969da; --error: #c5221f; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) { --fg: #e6edf3; --bg: #1c1c1e; --muted: #9198a1; --line: #3d444d;
        --code: #2c2c2e; --accent: #4493f8; --error: #f28b82; } }
:root[data-theme="dark"] { --fg: #e6edf3; --bg: #1c1c1e; --muted: #9198a1; --line: #3d444d;
        --code: #2c2c2e; --accent: #4493f8; --error: #f28b82; }
html { background: var(--bg); }
body { margin: 0; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
main { max-width: 52rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem 3rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { margin: 1.5em 0 .6em; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; }
h1 { font-size: 2em; padding-bottom: .3em; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
h2 { font-size: 1.5em; padding-bottom: .3em; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
h3 { font-size: 1.25em; } h4 { font-size: 1em; } h5 { font-size: .875em; } h6 { font-size: .85em; color: var(--muted); }
main > :first-child { margin-top: 0; }
p, ul, ol, blockquote, pre, table, .diagram { margin: 0 0 1em; }
a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; } a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
blockquote { margin-left: 0; padding: 0 1em; color: var(--muted); border-left: .25em solid var(--line); }
code, pre { font: 85% ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }
code { padding: .2em .4em; background: var(--code); border-radius: 6px; }
pre { padding: 1em; overflow: auto; line-height: 1.45; background: var(--code); border-radius: 6px; }
pre code { padding: 0; background: none; font-size: 100%; }
table { border-collapse: collapse; display: block; max-width: 100%; overflow: auto; }
th, td { padding: .4em .8em; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
th { font-weight: 600; } tr:nth-child(2n) td { background: var(--code); }
img { max-width: 100%; }
hr { height: 2px; border: 0; background: var(--line); margin: 1.5em 0; }
li.task-list-item { list-style: none; } li.task-list-item input { margin: 0 .4em 0 -1.4em; }
.math.display { display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; padding: .3em 0; margin: .5em 0; text-align: center; }
math[display="block"] { margin: 0; }
.diagram { text-align: center; overflow: auto; } .diagram svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.note { display: inline-block; padding: .2em .6em; font-size: 85%; color: var(--muted); border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 6px; }
.note.error, .failed { color: var(--error); }
details.toc, details.front-matter { margin: 0 0 1.25em; padding: .5em .9em; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; }
details.toc summary, details.front-matter summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font-size: 90%; }
details.toc ul { list-style: none; margin: .5em 0 0; padding: 0; }
details.toc li { margin: .15em 0; }
details.front-matter pre { margin: .6em 0 0; }

/* Light or dark as chosen in the preview (see setTheme), else as the
   system is. */
:root[data-theme="light"] { color-scheme: light; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] { color-scheme: dark; }
/* Code's colours, by highlight.js, in text previews (see colour in preview.js) and
   Markdown's code blocks (see md-frame.js), light and dark. */
pre.coloured code { font: inherit; }
.hljs-comment, .hljs-quote { color: #6a737d; font-style: italic; }
.hljs-keyword, .hljs-selector-tag, .hljs-literal, .hljs-doctag, .hljs-type, .hljs-meta .hljs-keyword { color: #cf222e; }
.hljs-string, .hljs-regexp, .hljs-meta .hljs-string, .hljs-char.escape_ { color: #0a3069; }
.hljs-number, .hljs-variable, .hljs-template-variable, .hljs-attr, .hljs-attribute, .hljs-selector-attr,
.hljs-selector-class, .hljs-selector-id, .hljs-symbol, .hljs-bullet, .hljs-link { color: #0550ae; }
.hljs-title, .hljs-section, .hljs-title.class_, .hljs-title.function_ { color: #8250df; }
.hljs-built_in, .hljs-name, .hljs-tag, .hljs-selector-pseudo, .hljs-property { color: #116329; }
.hljs-meta, .hljs-params { color: #953800; }
.hljs-addition { color: #116329; background: #dafbe1; }
.hljs-deletion { color: #82071e; background: #ffebe9; }
.hljs-emphasis { font-style: italic; } .hljs-strong { font-weight: 600; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-comment, :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-quote { color: #8b949e; }
       :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-keyword, :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-selector-tag, :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-literal, :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-doctag, :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-type, :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .hljs-meta .hljs-keyword { color: #ff7b72; }

This is an ES6-modules-compatible version of
https://github.com/nodeca/pako, based on pako version 1.0.3.

It's more-or-less a direct translation of the original, with unused parts
removed, and the dynamic support for non-typed arrays removed (since ES6
modules don't work well with dynamic exports).
